description: This file implements a FastAPI API route for retrieving the current authenticated user's profile information, including display name, using Supabase as the backend. It defines dependencies, response models, and route handlers to fetch user data from various sources with fallbacks.

classes.name: CurrentUserProfileResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the response containing user profile information.

methods.name: SupabaseClient get_supabase(settings=Depends(get_settings))
methods.description: Provides a Supabase client configured with settings; used for database operations.

methods.name: Optional[str] _resolve_current_user( supabase: SupabaseClient, authorization: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Resolves the current user's ID from an authorization token by querying Supabase authentication.

methods.name: CurrentUserProfileResponse get_me( supabase: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase), authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="Authorization"), )
methods.description: API endpoint for fetching the current user's display name and profile info, with fallback mechanisms.
